response.text: The checkout container exits immediately because its GOMEMLIMIT environment variable is not a memory size. The newest Sandbox commit changed only that value.

structured.diagnosis: The checkout Deployment crash-loops because its GOMEMLIMIT environment variable is set to not-a-size, which the Go runtime refuses at start. The newest Sandbox commit changed that value, so reverting the commit restores the known-good configuration.

findings.summary: The checkout container exited with a configuration error and its pod reports CrashLoopBackOff.
The newest Sandbox commit changed the checkout GOMEMLIMIT value to not-a-size.
